title: 第十七章强势的王朗第十八章苏阳现身
content_zh:
“父亲！！”看着自己父亲一跃而去的背影，李珊珊早已双眸含泪，不由伸出右手，似乎想要紧紧拉住那道背影。
“大小姐，还请随末将离去吧，不要辜负城主的心愿。”杨将军神情也很悲伤，但他只是将军，不敢不从城主之令。
李珊珊依旧站在原地发愣，即便不舍，但她心中也清楚，此刻只能离去。
然而，就在杨将军准备带李珊珊离去之时，李珊珊在茫茫夜色中，看见了一道隐匿的身影，身影速度极快，只是一刹那就消失在了黑暗之中。
即便如此，李珊珊也感觉到了一股极为熟悉的气息。
那股气息虽然很是遥远，但却始终很近.....
这让李珊珊不由心中想着：“好熟悉的感觉.....莫非那道黑影是我熟悉的人不成？”
杨将军见李珊珊还在发愣，便拉扯道：“大小姐，别犹豫了。趁现在王家还没注意到我们，赶紧出城吧。”
说罢，也不顾李珊珊困惑的表情，带着一队人马拉着李珊珊就朝外走。
就在杨将军即将出城的时候，殊不知早有埋伏在等待着他。
“嘿嘿，杨将军，这是准备去哪里啊？”
三道身影从黑暗中闪出，挡在了杨将军等人的面前。
当看清三人面容之后，杨将军不由神色一变道：“是你们！！黑风三兄弟。”
.....
苏府内，大战十分惨烈。
苏强与王子祥旗鼓相当，二人身上皆有负伤，一时半会也分不出胜负。三长老和四长老面对的对手也十分强悍，双方你来我往，都在浴血奋战！！！
而苏北楼此时，也在与王朗交手。
只不过一眼就能看出，二人之间的差距，有点太过明显。
“苏北楼，你就这点本事吗？看来本家主倒是高看了你，我劝你还是自己受死，免得等会死无全尸。”王朗从始至终，都还未出过一招，仅仅只是在躲闪着苏北楼的攻势。
后者此刻无比恼怒，但也无比绝望，他知道自己和王朗之间的差距，他不过才神武境三品修为，而王朗早就突破到了神武境五品。

虽然只差两个小品阶，这之间的差距也如同沟壑。
“少废话，士可杀不可辱，王朗！老夫今天无论如何也不会让你全身而退。”
“喝！高级功法《三阳烈火掌》。”
苏北楼怒喝一声，整个人气势爆发，灵气汇聚双掌之上，升腾出一股股烈火。
三玄之气由全身弥漫到双掌之上，烈火的力量再度增强。
“哦？看来你终于要动真格的了，居然连你苏家的绝学都拿出来了，也罢，念在你我之间也算有过交情，就让你死的痛快一些。”
“高级功法《天罡莽牛劲》。”面对苏北楼的强势攻击，王朗即便再自负，也不敢在此刻托大。
再怎么说，苏北楼也是神武境的高手，真要是不要命来，王朗也吃不消。
顿时，苏北楼双掌在虚空爆发出可怕火焰，强大的气息将其包裹，，朝着王朗开始了疯狂攻击。
每轰出一拳，拍出一掌，都带有狂暴的火焰之力。
content_en:
"Father!!" Looking at her father's back as he jumped away, Li Shanshan already had tears in her eyes. She couldn't help but stretched out her right hand, as if she wanted to hold the back tightly.
"Miss, please leave with me, don't let down the city lord's wishes." General Yang also looked very sad, but he was only a general and did not dare to disobey the city lord's orders.
Li Shanshan still stood there in a daze. Even though she was reluctant to leave, she knew in her heart that she could only leave at this moment.
However, just when General Yang was about to take Li Shanshan away, Li Shanshan saw a hidden figure in the vast night. The figure was very fast and disappeared into the darkness in just an instant.
Even so, Li Shanshan felt a very familiar aura.
Although that breath is very far away, it is always very close...
This made Li Shanshan think in her mind: "It feels so familiar... Could it be that that black shadow is someone I know well?"
Seeing that Li Shanshan was still in a daze, General Yang said, "Miss, don't hesitate. Let's leave the city quickly before the Wang family notices us."
After that, regardless of Li Shanshan's confused expression, he led a team of people and pulled Li Shanshan out.
Just when General Yang was about to leave the city, he didn't know there was an ambush waiting for him.
"Hey, General Yang, where are you going?"
Three figures flashed out of the darkness and stood in front of General Yang and others.
After seeing the faces of the three people clearly, General Yang couldn't help but change his expression and said: "It's you!! The three Black Wind brothers."
.....
In the Su Mansion, the battle was fierce.
Su Qiang and Wang Zixiang were evenly matched, both of them were injured, and for a while it was impossible to tell the winner. The opponents faced by the third elder and the fourth elder were also very tough. Both sides went back and forth, fighting bloody battles! ! !
At this time, Su Beilou was also fighting with Wang Lang.
But it can be seen at a glance that the gap between the two is a bit too obvious.
"Su Beilou, is this all you have? It seems that the head of the family thinks highly of you. I advise you to die on your own, so as not to die without a complete body later." From the beginning to the end, Wang Lang had not made a single move, he was just dodging Su Beilou's offensive.
The latter was extremely angry at the moment, but also extremely desperate. He knew the gap between himself and Wang Lang. He was only at the third level of the Divine Martial Realm, while Wang Lang had already broken through to the fifth level of the Divine Martial Realm.
Although there is only two minor grades, the gap between them is like a ravine.
"Stop talking nonsense, a scholar can be killed but not humiliated, Wang Lang! I will not let you escape unscathed today no matter what."
"Drink! The advanced skill "Three Yang Fire Palm"."
Su Beilou roared angrily, and his whole aura exploded. Spiritual energy gathered on his palms, rising up into streams of fire.
The energy of the Three Mysteries spread from the whole body to both palms, and the power of the fire increased again.
"Oh? It seems that you are finally serious about it. You even brought out the secret knowledge of your Su family. Anyway, since we have had friendship before, I will let you die a happy death."
"Advanced Cultivation Technique "Tiangang Mangniu Jin"." Faced with Su Beilou's strong attack, no matter how conceited Wang Lang was, he did not dare to boast at this moment.
After all, Su Beilou is also a master in the divine martial realm. If he really risked his life, Wang Lang wouldn't be able to bear it.
Immediately, Su Beilou's palms erupted into terrifying flames in the void, and a powerful aura enveloped them, and he began to attack Wang Lang crazily.
Every punch and palm struck was filled with the power of violent flames.
